description: Kiddie-pool authoring support (tiny above-ground ~200-ball pit + a placeholder container prefab via the editor menu) and the Deliverable-C handoff docs (brief sections 3.7, 4; DESIGN-C section 7). Depends on FEAT-001: the placeholder container prefab assembles a MassFillView.
steps: EDIT Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Editor/GameplayAssetMenu.cs: add `Tools/Ball Pit/Create Placeholder Container`. It creates (never overwrites; ping+select if present) a prefab assembling the three CONTAINER-3-PARTS: (1) a placeholder visual mesh (Unity primitive cube/cylinder vessel body), (2) a child intake box sized to BallContainer.intakeCenterLocal/intakeSizeLocal (the 'trigger' rectangle — geometry TryIntake tests, NOT a physics trigger; confirmed BallContainer.cs), (3) an Interactable collider on the balls/interactable layer so PlayerInteractor can aim at it, plus the BallContainer component and a MassFillView whose fill-volume child mesh is framed to the vessel. Reuse the existing EnsureFolder + never-overwrite + AssetDatabase + ping pattern (confirmed GameplayAssetMenu.cs).

EDIT Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Editor/GameplayAssetMenu.cs: add `Tools/Ball Pit/Create Kiddie Profile` that appends a kiddie PitSizeProfile (key="kiddie", pitX=10,pitY=2,pitZ=10 = 200 balls per owner Q4, ballDiameter=0.5) to the active VenueConfig resource, or logs how to create the asset if none exists — mirroring the Create Default Gameplay Assets pattern. 200 balls is well under MaxGpuBalls and ballDiameter=0.5 is within the supported range (confirmed VenueConfig.cs). No code constant hardcodes a kiddie size; it is DATA the menu seeds (keeps 'code never assumes a fixed layout').

NEW docs/handoff-C/DECISIONS-C.md: the design decisions + the owner questions Q1-Q6 from DESIGN-C at the top (fill-visual style = shaped scaled mesh default; settle-briefly-then-convert; dwell ~0.6s/on-rest; kiddie 10x2x10=200 at 0.5m; dev flags off by default; colorblind fill reads the applied display color).

NEW docs/handoff-C/HANDOFF-C.md: every new/modified file from FEAT-001..003 with a per-file edit list; the OWNER-COMPILE list (the interactor primary-edge consumption ordering; MassFillView driving only its child mesh — the 'containers flattened/moved under deck' regression must not recur; the kiddie profile loading from VenueConfig and a PitSite with profileKey="kiddie" passing VenueValidator) and the NGO note that C adds NO new NetworkBehaviour/NetworkVariable/RPC (GameplayNet is the only networked type, so no new codegen); the exact kiddie-pool authoring steps (anchor unrotated at FLOOR level for an above-ground pit; profileKey="kiddie"; rimHeight ~ visible pool-wall height which tunes the INVISIBLE collision proxy only, not the look — the visible pool wall is independent art that can stop at the ball surface, directly addressing the owner's 'walls forced too high' gripe; run the CONTEXT/PitSite 'Fit Venue Bounds To Pit' menu [VenueGizmos.cs:271] then widen for throw headroom; confirm the cyan interior gizmo; confirm no VenueValidator errors); placeholder container prefab + UpgradeStation + fill-view setup; a note that the owner must let Unity import the new scripts/prefab to generate .meta files; and a manual host+client test checklist matching brief section 5.

In HANDOFF-C add the short LAYERS section (Player/PlayerBody for the player, Interactable for containers, Layer 8 balls) and the CONTAINER-3-PARTS section (container = model / intake box / Interactable collider / fill view) called out by the brief.
acceptance_criteria: GameplayAssetMenu has two new menu items that create their assets without overwriting (ping+select on exist), following the existing EnsureFolder/AssetDatabase pattern.
The Create Placeholder Container prefab wires the three parts + BallContainer + MassFillView and validates under the existing BallContainerValidator/BallContainerGizmo.
The Create Kiddie Profile item appends a kiddie PitSizeProfile (10x2x10, 0.5m) to VenueConfig or logs how to create the asset; no hardcoded kiddie size constant in gameplay code.

HANDOFF-C.md lists every new/edited file from all three FEATs, the full OWNER-COMPILE list incl. the NGO note, the end-to-end kiddie-pool authoring steps, the placeholder/station/fill-view setup, the .meta import note, and a host+client test checklist; it includes the LAYERS and CONTAINER-3-PARTS sections.
DECISIONS-C.md records the decisions and owner questions Q1-Q6.
verification: Trace the two menu items follow the never-overwrite/ping pattern and that the prefab assembles the three parts + BallContainer + MassFillView; confirm the existing validator/gizmo apply.
Trace the kiddie profile values against VenueConfig.PitSizeProfile fields + Sanitize/MaxGpuBalls/supported ballDiameter range; confirm 'Fit Venue Bounds To Pit' exists (VenueGizmos.cs:271).
Cross-check HANDOFF-C against the files touched by FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (read their findings) so no file or OWNER-COMPILE item is missing.

Owner play-test only: run the menu items in-editor; drop 3-4 containers and see sort->sell->fill with the right color; author the kiddie pool per the documented steps and confirm no VenueValidator errors.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (branch feat/kiddie-pool-slice). EDITED: Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Editor/GameplayAssetMenu.cs (two new menu items). NEW docs: docs/handoff-C/DECISIONS-C.md, docs/handoff-C/HANDOFF-C.md. NO .meta files authored (owner re-imports; the placeholder prefab's .meta is generated when the owner runs the menu item in-editor).

MENU ITEM 1 - 'Tools/Ball Pit/Create Placeholder Container': creates (never overwrites; pings+selects if present) Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Containers/Placeholders/PlaceholderContainer.prefab via PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset. Assembles CONTAINER-3-PARTS: (1) VesselBody primitive cube (its own BoxCollider is the Interactable collider, left on default layer for the owner to set), (2) IntakeBox child = isTrigger BoxCollider marker sized 1x0.5x1 at local (0,1,0) matching the BallContainer intake defaults (NOT a physics trigger - geometry marker only; BallContainerGizmo draws the real tested box), (3) FillVolume child primitive cube with its BoxCollider removed (purely visual). Root carries BallContainer (SerializedObject sets id='placeholder', colorIndex=0, intakeCenterLocal=(0,1,0), intakeSizeLocal=(1,0.5,1)) + MassFillView (SerializedObject sets fillVolume=FillVolume.transform, fillRenderer=FillVolume MeshRenderer, emptyScaleY=0.001, fullScaleY=0.9, emptyPosY=0.05, fullPosY=0.5). Uses FEAT-001's EXACT MassFillView serialized field names (fillVolume/fillRenderer/emptyScaleY/fullScaleY/emptyPosY/fullPosY) and BallContainer's (id/colorIndex/intakeCenterLocal/intakeSizeLocal) - both traced against the real sources.

MENU ITEM 2 - 'Tools/Ball Pit/Create Kiddie Profile': appends a kiddie PitSizeProfile (key='kiddie', displayName='Kiddie Pool', pitX=10/pitY=2/pitZ=10 = 200 balls, ballDiameter=0.5, players 1-4) to the VenueConfig at Assets/Game/BallPitGameplay/Resources/BallPitVenueConfig.asset (or the loaded Resources config) via SerializedObject on the private 'profiles' list. Never overwrites an existing 'kiddie' key (scans the array, pings instead); logs how to run Create Default Venue Config if no VenueConfig exists. 200 balls << MaxGpuBalls and 0.5 m is in SupportedMin/MaxBallDiameter, so VenueConfig.Sanitize accepts it; players clamp to MaxPlayers=4 anyway. No code constant hardcodes a kiddie size (it is DATA).

TRACED SIGNATURES CONFIRMED against real worktree sources: GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube) (adds MeshFilter+MeshRenderer+BoxCollider); PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(GameObject, string, out bool); AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject/VenueConfig>; EditorGUIUtility.PingObject; Selection.activeObject; the existing EnsureFolder helper; BallContainer serialized fields id/colorIndex/intakeCenterLocal/intakeSizeLocal + OnValidate id key rule ^[a-z0-9_.]{1,64}$ ('placeholder' passes); MassFillView serialized fields + OnValidate (fillVolume assigned so no warning); VenueConfig private 'profiles' List<PitSizeProfile> + PitSizeProfile fields key/displayName/pitX/pitY/pitZ/ballDiameter/recommendedPlayersMin/recommendedPlayersMax/estimatedPlayTime/notes + ResourcePath + Sanitize ranges (MaxGpuBalls, Supported ball diameter); PitAuthority.MaxPlayers=4; PitSite.TryApplyTo/RimHeight/profileKey + 'Fit Venue Bounds To Pit' at VenueGizmos.cs; BallContainerValidator (Validate Containers) + BallContainerGizmo draw the intake box; PlayerInteractor.interactableMask LayerMask; PlayerLayers.Player/PlayerBody + PitSettings.ballLayer (default 8).

HANDOFF-C.md lists every new/edited file from FEAT-001, FEAT-002 (cross-checked against commits 93132d9 and acc0a45) and FEAT-003 with per-file edit lists; the full OWNER-COMPILE list incl. the interactor primary-edge ordering, the MassFillView child-only drive (the 'containers flattened/under deck' regression guard), the kiddie profile load/validate, and the NGO note (C adds NO new NetworkBehaviour/NetworkVariable/RPC; GameplayNet is the only networked type); the exact kiddie-pool authoring steps (anchor at floor unrotated, profileKey=kiddie, rimHeight tunes the invisible proxy not the visible art, Fit Venue Bounds To Pit, cyan gizmo, VenueValidator); placeholder container + station + fill-view setup; the .meta re-import note; the host+client test checklist (brief section 5); and the LAYERS + CONTAINER-3-PARTS sections. DECISIONS-C.md records the decisions + owner questions Q1-Q6.

OWNER-COMPILE (cannot verify here, no Unity on agent machine): compile GameplayAssetMenu.cs; run both menu items; the placeholder prefab validates under BallContainerValidator/BallContainerGizmo; the kiddie PitSite passes VenueValidator; set the Interactable layer on the container root + add it to PlayerInteractor.interactableMask. BOUNDARIES HELD: editor-only code; no edits to NetPit/PitReplica/MultiplayerKit; collapse sim untouched; GpuBallRenderer untouched; no NGO codegen.
